title: refactor: share general CMOrd star-subdivision multiplicity proofs between ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity and ExistsSmoothFanInt
body:
Generalize the star-subdivision multiplicity-reduction chain from CM-field hosts `(E, H)` to arbitrary Dedekind orders `(O, bar, w0)` with `CMOrd O bar` so that `Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/IwasawaDecomposition/ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean` and `CompanionTheory/SpectralGeometry/LocalGlobalProofs/ConvexCones/ExistsSmoothFanInt.lean` share a single implementation instead of duplicating 8 theorems across both files.

Specifically:
- Expose `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.cmOrd_host` in `ExistsMarkedFormPiecesRaysOfSimplicialCells.lean` (adding `public import CompanionTheory.SpectralGeometry.CountingDefinitions.VoronoiMeans.VorFunEvalEqFineMean`).
- Generalize `GlobalTheory.PolFan.cellMult_lt_of_star_new` in `StarSubdivisionNewCellMultiplicityLt.lean` from `(E, H)` to `(O, bar)`.
- Move the general `(O, bar, w0, CMOrd O bar)` star-subdivision theorems from `ExistsSmoothFanInt.lean` into `ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean`, factor out `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_round_lt_maxMult_of_multCells`, and remove the 7 unreferenced CM-host intermediate theorems and unused private imports.
- Delegate both `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_round_lt_maxMult` (in `ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean`) and `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.RoundBelowMaxMultiplicity.exists_round_lt_maxMult` (in `ExistsSmoothFanInt.lean`) to `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_round_lt_maxMult_of_multCells`.

Declarations changed:
- Exposed: `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.cmOrd_host` (in `ExistsMarkedFormPiecesRaysOfSimplicialCells.lean`, previously `private`).
- Generalized: `GlobalTheory.PolFan.cellMult_lt_of_star_new` (in `StarSubdivisionNewCellMultiplicityLt.lean`).
- Added: `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_round_lt_maxMult_of_multCells` (in `ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean`).
- Moved (from `ExistsSmoothFanInt.lean` to `ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean`, preserving full names):
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.OrbitMarkUniqueInCell.eq_of_orbMark_of_inRCone_cell`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.OrbitMarkCoordinateBound.orbMark_coord_lt_one`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.TwistedOrbitCentres.isTwG_orbFun`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.TwistedOrbitCentres.centres_exists`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.TwistedStarLabelling.isTwG_starLab`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.TwistedStarLabelling.exists_isTwG_simpLab_star`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.OldCellsStarMultiplicity.starOld_cell_mult_le`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.StarMultiplicity.starMult`
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.StarSubdivisionDropsCells.exists_star_drop_multCells`
- Removed (unreferenced duplicates):
  - `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.NewCellsStarMultiplicity.cellMult_lt_of_star_new` (from `ExistsSmoothFanInt.lean`, replaced by generalized `GlobalTheory.PolFan.cellMult_lt_of_star_new`)
  - `GlobalTheory.PolFan.eq_of_orbMark_of_inRCone_cell`, `GlobalTheory.orbMark_coord_lt_one`, `GlobalTheory.PolFan.OrbMark.centres_exists`, `GlobalTheory.PolFan.StarLab.exists_isTwInv_simpLab_star`, `GlobalTheory.PolFan.starOld_cell_mult_le`, `GlobalTheory.PolFan.starMult`, `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_star_drop_multCells` (from `ExistsStarSubdivisionLowersMaxCellMultiplicity.lean`).
- Refactored: `GlobalTheory.PolFan.exists_round_lt_maxMult` and `GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.Fan.RoundBelowMaxMultiplicity.exists_round_lt_maxMult` (unchanged signatures).
